tagline: CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER  ·  WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT  ·  FACILITIES SERVICES  ·  GOVERNMENT CONTRACTS & COMPLIANCE  ·  GROWTH
profile: Operations executive who scales workforce-development and service organizations while holding them to contractual, regulatory, and financial goals. Led a 140-person, multi-program division with full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio, running employment programs and earned-revenue service lines, including facility services, landscaping, warehouse cleaning, and power washing, that employed people returning from incarceration. Reversed a $1M operating deficit into a 13% surplus, negotiated $10M+ in government and institutional contracts, and directed controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts. Built a clean-energy workforce program from inception with 92% certificate completion and partnered with NYSID on projects employing people with disabilities. Develops high-performing leadership teams through KPIs, coaching, and a steady management cadence.

bullets.text: Created and led an 18-month NYPA clean-energy workforce program from inception; piloted the model before rollout; 92% of enrolled participants completed training and earned a certificate.
Worked with NYSID on public-sector projects employing individuals with disabilities.
Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development & Social Ventures

bullets.text: Held full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio; led financial and operational oversight of a 140-person, multi-program division.
Reversed a $1M annual operating deficit and delivered a 13% operating surplus through cost restructuring, financial controls, and revenue optimization.
Developed revenue-generating social ventures that combined financial sustainability with mission outcomes.
Built pricing, monetization plans, and budgets for earned-revenue service lines, including landscaping and warehouse cleaning.
Owned an employment and workforce-development model integrating job readiness, placement, and wraparound supports for justice-impacted participants.
Ran staffing capacity for all 140 employees, managing staff hours, overtime, bonuses, and raises against budget.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
Served as financial architect for a $200M national banking-development initiative, supporting capital planning and financial structuring.
Developed operational and performance-improvement strategies for $50M+ organizations and major brands.
Built accounting, governance, and operational infrastructure for an international NGO serving children in Haiti.
Managed landlord relationships, leases, facilities, insurance, utilities, and vendor contracts across multiple locations.
Wrote safety plans and procedures for the company and its five locations, including franchise sites.
Built HR, payroll, benefits, and training infrastructure for a team that grew from 4 to 60 full-time employees.
Founded and scaled a multi-location business from a $5K investment to a $1M enterprise; delivered 33% YoY revenue growth and an 11% margin improvement.
